name: ShopElement
author: StorePlugin

sections.description:
With ShopElement you can add many widget of Elementor on your store. Custom product grid, product category, product features and so many other widget.

Key features:

  • Product Grid Widget
  • Product List Widget
  • Store Feature Widget
  • Product Carousel Widget
  • Product Banner Widget
  • Brand Logo Widget
  • Customer Review Carousel Widget
  • Product Category Widget

PRO Features

  • Product Grid Widget ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Product List Widget ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Product Carousel Widget ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Product Banner Widget ( Premium 4 Layout )
  • Customer Review Carousel Widget ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Product Category Widget ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Image Marker with Product ( Premium 2 Layout )
  • Product Image Accordion ( Premium 2 Layout )

👉 Get ShopElement Pro
